name: CICO
description:
Call In Coroutine Override (CICO), originally created by NextBot developer Roach.
Temporarily replaces LADBot's normal behavior coroutine with a callback.
The callback may use yielding helpers such as PlaySequenceAndWait, allowing code
to run sequentially before and after animations or other waits. Normal behavior
remains paused until the callback returns, after which the previous behavior
coroutine is restored if another system has not already replaced it.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Code to run inside the temporary behavior coroutine. Receives this LADBot as its only argument.

examples.code:
self:CICO(function(self)
    self._isWaving = true
    self:PlaySequenceAndWait("waving_animation")
    self._isWaving = false
end)

name: CICO
description:
Client-side counterpart to Call In Coroutine Override (CICO).
Runs a callback inside a temporary client behavior coroutine and restores
the previous behavior coroutine after the callback returns. Most addon code
should use the server implementation; this version exists for clientside
coroutine sequences.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Code to run inside the temporary client behavior coroutine. Receives this LADBot as its only argument.

name: Multithread
description:
Cooperatively runs multiple callbacks as child coroutines and waits for all of them to finish.
Each suspended callback is resumed once per update, allowing callbacks which yield to make progress
alongside one another. This is not true parallel execution: a callback which never yields runs to
completion before the next callback is resumed. Call this from a yieldable coroutine, such as a CICO
callback. Return values are discarded, and errors raised by callbacks are not propagated by the current
implementation.

parameters.name: funcs
parameters.description: An array of zero-argument callbacks to run cooperatively.

name: OnContact

ENT:CustomOnContact(ent) is called at the end of this function, allowing for additional custom behavior.

name: GetLockedInDirectionalTarget
description:
Returns the best enemy candidate in the direction the possessor is pressing (WASD, 8-way),
or nil if no suitable candidate passes all three filters:
   1. Edge-triggered: caller only invokes this on a direction change (see PossessionThink).
   2. Angular separation: candidate must be >20 degrees away from current target
      (avoids switching between enemies that are essentially overlapping from our POV).
   3. Hysteresis: candidate must outscore the current target by a margin of 0.15
      (avoids switching to a marginally better-aligned enemy in a tight cluster).

name: DeathRagdoll
description:
Death ragdoll — spawns a permanent physics ragdoll with per-bone animation
velocities so every limb carries the momentum it had at the moment of death.
Only active when lad_ragdollmode == 1 (checked at call-site in OnDeath).

name: DowningRagdoll
description:
Ragdoll triggered by a downing hit-reaction at a specific animation cycle.
The NPC is hidden behind a physics ragdoll for ragdoll_time seconds; it then
lerps its limbs toward the first frame of the appropriate get-up animation
and seamlessly transitions back to the NPC standing-up sequence.
Only active when lad_ragdollmode == 1.
Call this from inside your hit-reaction cycle callback — orientation flags
(DownedFront / DownedBack) must already be set by the time you call it.

name: _GetRootAnimVelocity
description:
Returns the root-motion velocity of the current animation sequence in world space.
Source model space: +X = forward, +Y = LEFT, +Z = up.
ang:Right() points to the RIGHT (-Y in model space), so the Y component must be
negated; otherwise lateral root-motion is applied in the opposite direction.

name: _RagdollApplyHitImpulse
description:
Applies a physics impulse to the active ragdoll at the nearest bone to hitPos.
Used by ApplyAttackDamage to make the ragdoll react to incoming hits.

name: _SpawnVelocityRagdoll
description:
Spawns a prop_ragdoll that exactly matches the NPC's current pose and applies
per-bone animation velocities so limbs carry momentum rather than freezing.
Returns the ragdoll entity (or nil on failure).

name: _TrackBoneVelocities
description:
Tracks per-bone world velocities every think tick by differencing positions.
Called automatically from the main think loop.  Only active while the NPC is
alive and not in an active ragdoll phase so we don't waste cycles.

fields.name: Damage

fields.name: Angle
fields.description: Angle of the attack, defaults to 150° if not specified.

fields.name: HitSounds
fields.description: A table of random sounds to play when the attack hits a target, also accepts strings "p" for stronger punch sounds and "none" for no hit sounds at all, defaults to weak punch sounds if not specified.

fields.name: MissSounds
fields.description: A table of random sounds to play when the attack misses a target, also accepts strings "swing_kick" for stronger miss sounds and "none" for no miss sounds at all, defaults to weak swing sounds if not specified.

fields.name: HitDowned
fields.description: Whether the attack hits downed targets, defaults to false if not specified.

fields.name: HitOnce
fields.description: Whether the attack hits one target once, defaults to false if not specified.

fields.name: HitReset
fields.description: Used in conjuction with HitOnce, defaults to 3 if not specified.

fields.name: HitProps
fields.description: Whether the attack hits props, defaults to false if not specified.

fields.name: HitPropsUp
fields.description: Upward velocity when a prop is hit, defaults to 200 if not specified.

fields.name: HitPropsForward
fields.description: Forward velocity when a prop is hit, defaults to 500 if not specified.

fields.name: TargetiFrames
fields.description: Whether the attack can target immunity frames, defaults to false if not specified.

fields.name: Bone
fields.description: TBD

fields.name: Delay
fields.description: Delay before the attack code runs, defaults to 0 if not specified.

fields.name: Side
fields.description: Side of the attack, accepts "front", "back", "left", "right", defaults to "front" if not specified.

fields.name: Knockback
fields.description: Knockback force of the attack which affects regular NPCs, defaults to a math.random(120, 140) if not specified.

fields.name: KnockbackUp
fields.description: Knockback upwards force of the attack which affects regular NPCs, defaults to 10 if not specified.

fields.name: DamageBuddha
fields.description: Attack doesn't kill the target, even if damage is greater than their health, defaults to false if not specified.

fields.name: Wallbounce
fields.description: TBD

fields.name: WallbounceReaction
fields.description: TBD

fields.name: Attacker
fields.description: Who performed the attack? Defaults to self if not specified.

fields.name: Origin
fields.description: Origin of the attack, defaults to self:WorldSpaceCenter() if not specified.

fields.name: AttackType
fields.description: Defines attack type specifically when hitting guards, accepts "sude", "metal", "katana", "bokuto", "bullet"; defaults to "sude" if not specified. TODO: rename this to something else? The naming is a bit confusing.

fields.name: WeaponSlot
fields.description: Defines which weapon slot the attack is coming from, defaults to 1 (right hand) if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: DeductWeaponDurability
fields.description: How much weapon durability to deduct if attack hits a target, defaults to true/1 if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: WeaponDamageMultiplier
fields.description: Multiplies weapon damage by this value, defaults to 1 if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: UseWeaponDamage
fields.description: Whether to use weapon attack damage, defaults to false if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: UseWeaponRange
fields.description: Whether to use weapon attack range, defaults to false if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: UseWeaponAngle
fields.description: Whether to use weapon attack angle, defaults to false if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: UseWeaponHitSounds
fields.description: Whether to use weapon attack hit sounds, defaults to false if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: UseWeaponMissSounds
fields.description: Whether to use weapon attack miss sounds, defaults to false if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: UseWeaponAttackType
fields.description: Whether to use weapon attack type, defaults to false if not specified (attacker must have a weapon).

fields.name: Force
fields.description: Force of the attack, defaults to Vector(3000,0,0) if not specified, mainly affects ragdolls and physics props.

fields.name: ViewPunch
fields.description: View punch, only affects default GMod player entities.

fields.name: _syncvictim
fields.description: Sync victim, internal use only, defaults to nil if not specified.

name: _GetSoundtrackRecipients
description:
Returns a list of all Player recipients for this entity's soundtrack events.
Includes own possessor (if possessed and satisfies combatCheck) plus possessors of
all other possessed fighters currently in the same battle.
selfIgnoreCombat = true skips the FighterInCombat check for self only
                    (used during battle-start anim where FighterInCombat is not yet set).

name: _LoadSoundtrackDef
description: Loads and caches a soundtrack definition file from data_static. Returns { name, hasEnd } or nil.

name: _SendSoundtrackStart
description:
Sends LAD_SoundtrackStart to all eligible recipients (own possessor and battle allies' possessors).
Pass ignoreCombatCheck = true to send before FighterInCombat is set (battle start anim path).
Pass skipIntro = true to jump straight to the loop (used on moveset switches mid-combat).
Pass waitForIntro = true to defer a moveset switch until the current _start intro finishes.
Pass directRecipient (Player) to force-add a specific player when the entity is unpossessed
and has no battle yet (e.g. endless boss intro).

description:
Create a new battle from a list of participant entities. Returns the battle ID.
All listed fighters receive _battleID = <id> immediately so that ActivateCombat
(which may fire later inside a CICO coroutine) can find the existing battle.
opts (optional table): { endless = true } — battle never declares victory/defeat;
   CheckBattleEnd returns early so the record stays alive for the next wave.

name: FindNearestBattle
description:
Find the ID of the nearest active battle within maxDist units of pos.
Returns nil if none is found.

name: Join
description:
Add a fighter to an existing battle as a late joiner (no intro animation).
Returns true on success.

name: Leave
description:
Remove a fighter from their current battle.
checkEnd: pass true to immediately re-evaluate whether the battle should end
           (e.g. after a kill). Pass false during bulk cleanup (OnRemove) to
           avoid operating on partially-removed entity state.

name: Merge
description:
Merge two battles into one. All fighters from dissolveID are re-registered under keepID.
The dissolveID battle record is dissolved. All fighter._battleID values are updated.
